characters.label: Hello Kitty
characters.rights: Official SANRIO/Hello Kitty public animated preview of a paid LINE sticker product. No separate game-use/redistribution license established.
characters.notes: 33 genuine source frames, classic outfit, turning head, magnifying-glass arm motion and facial changes. Magnifying glass remains part of authentic source pose. Original turns between three-quarter RIGHT and full RIGHT profile. Pixel mirroring makes three-quarter LEFT/full LEFT profile. Not a flipped frontal-only pose.

characters.interpolation: Bidirectional dense optical-flow resampling of existing source pixels; no redrawn character details.

characters.label: Ultraman
characters.rights: Page says original game graphics remain original copyright holders' property, supplied for private/non-commercial use. No new license grant from the copyright holder was established.
characters.notes: Ten original full-gait walking poses plus dedicated idle, punch, flinch and collapse poses. Fixed source-pixel scale and foot anchors across actions. Playback cadence12fps is an adaptation; sheet does not encode original timings.
characters.processing: Source pixels cropped uniformly, resized and WebP-compressed; no character redrawing or image generation.
characters.interpolation: Bidirectional dense optical-flow resampling of existing source pixels; no redrawn character details.

characters.label: Team Rocket
characters.rights: Genuine Pokemon anime footage hosted by Tenor; no standalone game redistribution or commercial license established.
characters.notes: Nineteen genuine anime running frames at20fps. Both trainers animate; same-frame anime Meowth is extracted and rides James’s tracked shoulder. Source silhouettes masked, trainers mirrored leftward; view remains frontal/three-quarter. No redrawing.
characters.processing: Source silhouettes manually guided and GrabCut masked, genuine source frames preserved. Trainers horizontally mirrored. Same-frame native anime Meowth extracted, resized and placed on tracked James shoulder. Uniform canvas and no character redraw. Uniform WebP atlas with optical-flow playback frames; source timing retained.
characters.interpolation: Bidirectional dense optical-flow resampling of existing source pixels; no redrawn character details.
characters.orientationNote: Trainers are leftward three-quarter/front after mirroring; Meowth is frontal/slightly leftward. This is genuine source-view motion, not a strict side-profile running cycle.

characters.label: 7 Days to Die 1.0 Demolisher / Demolition Zombie
characters.rights: Third-party game imagery, 7 Days to Die / The Fun Pimps. No standalone asset redistribution or commercial game-use license established.
characters.notes: Gently articulated original still source pixels; NOT native game animation. Independent small head, forearm and shin rotations. Full body preserved; local combat statistics are fixed classroom adaptations, not original7DTD combat parity.

motion.limitations: Niu Lai uses genuine up-left profile/head motion with source-cropped foot tips. Dog Man uses three movie running poses; Pikachu uses an expressive crouched cycle. Team Rocket uses genuine leftward three-quarter/front running footage; Meowth remains frontal/slightly leftward. These sources are not complete walk/attack sets.
